lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Has anyone seen my pizza? I left half of it in the fridge.
lines.zh: 有人看到我的披萨了吗？我在冰箱里留了一半。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.zh: 也许吧。你说的“看到”是什么意思？

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Leo, did you eat my pizza?
lines.zh: 利奥，你吃了我的披萨吗？

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: In my defense, it was very lonely in there.
lines.zh: 我辩解一下，它一个人待在那儿很孤单。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: That was my dinner for tonight!

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: I will order a new one. Pineapple or no pineapple?
lines.zh: 我再订一份。要菠萝还是不要？

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Absolutely no pineapple. We have talked about this.
lines.zh: 绝对不要菠萝。我们谈过这个了。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Fine, but you are missing out on something great.
lines.zh: 好吧，但你错过了好东西。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: I will survive. Just make it large, and you are paying.
lines.zh: 我活得下去。点大份的，而且你付钱。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Deal. Next time, put your name on the box.
lines.zh: 成交。下次在盒子上写上你的名字。
